source_tables.title: Rates of Retirement by Age and Service

notes: The document provides retirement rates for '19 Years of Service or less' (Table B-13, page 73). The target grid requires service buckets starting at 5 years (5-11, 12-19, etc.) and extending to 40+. The source table only covers service < 20 years (specifically 0-19). There is no data in the document for service years 20 and above (20-24, 25-29, 30, 31-32, 33-34, 35-39, 40). Consequently, the row_map for these target rows has empty sources. The source table columns are groups (Police, Fire, Drivers, Craft, Misc) while the target columns are single ages. The target grid asks for 'Probability of retirement by service-year bucket (rows) x single age (columns)'. The source table is Age (Rows) x Group (Columns). The target requires Age (Columns) x Service (Rows). The source table does not have single-age columns; it has single-age rows. The target requires single-age columns. The source table does not have service buckets as columns; it has groups. The target requires service buckets as rows. The source table is Age x Group. The target is Service x Age. The source table does not contain the required Service dimension in the columns or rows in a way that maps to the target's Service buckets. The source table rows are Ages.
